name: News of Dogran
summary: A missing grunt named Dogran leaves Zankaja waiting in Orgrimmar. His mate has heard nothing for days, so she sends you to question his superior, Gazrog, at the Crossroads. For a warlock, the search also serves a ritual to bind a succubus.

sections.title: A Mate's Despair
sections.body: Zankaja waits on the bluffs of Orgrimmar, fearing for her mate Dogran. He was sent to the Crossroads on an honorable promotion, but his return is overdue and she has heard nothing for days. She asks you to seek news from his commander, Gazrog. She does not know that dark arts are at work behind the search.

sections.title: Grim Tidings in the Barrens
sections.body: Gazrog tells you what happened to Dogran at the Crossroads, the central Horde outpost in the Barrens. Quilboar infest the plains, and Dogran has fallen into their hands. He still lives, but his capture is a grim truth Gazrog hesitates to send back to Zankaja.

sections.title: An Instrument of Summoning
sections.body: The warlock's search for Dogran also serves the work of summoning and mastering a succubus. The binding ritual calls for relics touched by true emotion. Dogran's suffering and his bond with Zankaja provide the emotional conduit the ritual needs.

faq.answer: Dogran is an orc grunt stationed in the Barrens, recently promoted to the Crossroads. He is Zankaja's mate, and she lives in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Why does a warlock care about a missing orc guard?
faq.answer: Warlock mentors in the Cleft of Shadow direct you to seek news of Dogran. The binding ritual for a succubus needs relics touched by deep mortal emotions, including love, devotion, and suffering.
Gazrog is at the Crossroads in the Barrens, where he helps manage Horde defenses against local threats.
Dogran is overdue to return to Zankaja, who has heard nothing from him for days. She asks you to seek news from Gazrog at the Crossroads.

aliases: where to start news of dogran
faq.answer: Zankaja gives it to you on the bluffs of Orgrimmar, after the warlock trainer Cazul directs you to her.

faq.q: What comes next in the chain?
faq.answer: Continue your inquiries in the Barrens to learn Dogran's fate and carry the news onward.

angles.text: As a warlock, you move from dark texts in Orgrimmar to using mortal tragedy in your effort to claim a succubus.
As a member of the Horde, you see the danger its grunts face while securing the Crossroads of Kalimdor from hostile threats.
As an orc, you see in Zankaja's grief the personal cost of the Horde's expansion and defense across Durotar and the Barrens.
